__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.description:
The Elven Wizard looks at you in a solemn sort of way.  His gaze seems to
penetrate through your innermost being.  He is wearing a silvery cloak
and holding a multi-colored staff.  Although he appears to be older
than the oldest man, he seems to have an inner strength which most mortals
cannot overcome.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: An Elven Wizard is here, creating fireworks for the festivities.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: oldstyle elven wizard

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.description:
The Ring Keeper is a rather big but short halfling.  His short stature and
bulbous nose belie his true nature.  An elven sword that glows with a blue
light hangs from his belt, and on his finger you see the One Ring.  Although
usually a halfling of peace, he will fight you to the death if you attempt
to take away that which belongs to him.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: The Keeper of the Ring is here, guarding his treasure jealously.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: oldstyle ring keeper

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.description:
Farmer Gamgee is a short, stout halfling of thirty years.  His skin has
been tanned from working the fields night and day.  He's quite a jolly
chap, always ready to befriend an injured bunny rabbit.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: Farmer Gamgee sniffs the air, wondering if harvest time is near.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: oldstyle farmer gamgee

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.description:
The toddler is dressed in nothing but his birthday suit.  He crawls about
for he hasn't learned to walk yet.  He peers up at you and asks "da da?"
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: A toddler crawls about, looking for something to chew on.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: oldstyle toddler

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.description:
The nursemaid looks rather tired and worn out.  Taking care of so many
toddlers for too long has evidently taken its toll.  She looks to you and
in her eyes you can see her longing for a better life.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: A nursemaid wanders about, trying to keep track of all the toddlers.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: oldstyle nursemaid

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.description:
The cow looks like it hasn't been milked in quite some time.  Although she
is past her prime, you see that she still has a lot of years left, and that
if provoked, her rear kick can be quite deadly.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: A cow is here, chewing her cud.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: oldstyle cow

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.description:
The pig appears quite happy to be a pig.  He is oblivious to your presence
and cares only for the care-free life that he leads.  It is enormously fat
and consequently cannot move around very quickly.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: A pig wallows in the mud and oinks in contentment.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: oldstyle pig

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.description: The chicken is bright and healthy.  She has no weapons but her beak.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: A chicken sits on her nest.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: oldstyle chicken

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.description:
The bull is in top condition.  He looks like quite a fighter, nothing to be
reckoned with.  With his horns and his hooves he can attack just about
anything.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: A bull scratches at the ground and lowers his head.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: oldstyle bull

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.description: The horse looks at you and turns away.  You can tell that it is afraid of you.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: A horse becomes frightened by your presence.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: oldstyle horse

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.description:
The shiriff is over waist high, quite tall for a halfling.  His eyes are
ever roaming, looking for signs of trouble from riff-raff like you.  In
his belt is a thin dagger, and on his body he wears a suit of leather armor.
This is one halfling you don't want to mess with.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: A shiriff of the Shire looks for signs of trouble.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: oldstyle shiriff

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.description:
The shiriff is over waist high, quite tall for a halfling.  His eyes are
ever roaming, looking for signs of trouble from riff raff like you.  In
his belt is a thin dagger, and on his body he wears a suit of leather armor.
This is one halfling you don't want to mess with.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: A shiriff of the Shire looks for signs of trouble.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: oldstyle shiriff

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.description:
A personable yet serious halfling, the Thain looks at you and yells a
deep 'Hullo'.  He walks about comfortably, secure in the knowledge that
as long as he's in office, the Shire will always remain a safe haven for
Shire folk.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: The Thain commands respect from all Shire folk.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: oldstyle thain

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.description:
The Innkeeper is a jolly old halfling who spends his days eavesdropping on
local gossip.  In his younger days, he was quite a seasoned traveller.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: The Innkeeper stands here awaiting your order.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: oldstyle innkeeper

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.description:
The Miller is an impatient young halfling, always trying to command more
respect from his workers than he can get.  He looks like the type of person
who deserves a spanking but never got one.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: The Miller is here, overseeing his busy mill workers.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: oldstyle miller

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.description:
The mill worker is in fine shape from the hard labor that he does at the
mill.  He doesn't notice your presence, but he looks like he could break you
in two without thinking about it.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: The mill worker runs to and fro.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: oldstyle mill worker

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.description:
The tall elven warrior is light and fair-skinned.  The expression that he wears
on his countenance is solemn and tragic.  He cares not for this world any
longer and wearies of it.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: The elven warrior watches you solemnly.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: oldstyle elven warrior

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.description:
Grim and cold, the dwarven prince is quite strong and bulky, even for the
dwarves of his land.  His glowing eyes peer out of his bushy face and stare
beyond your gaze.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: The dwarven prince sits here patiently for the return of his king.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: oldstyle dwarven prince

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.description:
The shopkeeper will fight like a madman to protect his store from riff-raff
like you.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: The shopkeeper smiles and patiently waits for you to buy something.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: oldstyle shopkeeper

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.description:
The grocer is a large, jovial halfling who knows how to enjoy his pipeweed.
However, he also knows that it's worth protecting and so will do everything
in his power to prevent riff-raff like you from stealing it.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: The grocer offers you the finest breads in all the land.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: oldstyle grocer

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.description:
The blacksmith is a lean and mean fighting machine.  His knowledge of weapons
and armour would certainly help him in any fight against riff-raff like you.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: The blacksmith bids you welcome to his humble store.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: oldstyle blacksmith

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.description: The battle master is a wizened fighter, with many scars to prove his worth.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: The battle master offers you the services of his fine trainees.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: oldstyle battle master

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.description:
The halfling youth is not yet quite in the prime of his youth.  He's knee
high and you get the sudden urge to step on him.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: A halfling youth stands here, waiting for nothing in particular.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: oldstyle halfling youth

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.description:
The seasoned adventurer has seen his share of glory days.  Although he is
past his prime, he still looks like he could put up more than his share of
a good fight.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: A seasoned adventurer sits here, telling tales of fame and fortune.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: oldstyle seasoned adventurer

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.description:
The gossip is all talk and no action.  You're transfixed by her ability to
talk so much so quickly.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: A local gossip asks you, "Have you heard the latest?"
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: oldstyle local gossip

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.description:
She is the most beautiful creature you've seen in quite some time.  As you
stare at her, thoughts of all else vanish.  You get the sudden urge to grovel
at her feet, hoping she'll take you in like a lost puppy.  You wouldn't dare
harm a hair on her precious little head.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: A halfling beauty stares dreamily into your eyes.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: oldstyle halfling beauty

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.description:
The trainee smiles smugly, aware of your interest in him.  He's a little
fresh, but his enthusiasm and desire to please more than make up for what
he lacks in skill.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: A trainee screams a death cry as he delivers the fatal blow to a dummy.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: oldstyle trainee

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.description:
The urbanite seems very much at home in his surroundings.  His clothes are
all of the latest fashions and his manners impeccable.  He offers you some
coins if you'd be so good as to order a drink for him.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: A chic urbanite sits here, enjoying his class status.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: oldstyle chic urbanite

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.description: The country bumpkin snores noisily.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: A country bumpkin dreams of pipeweed and its many uses.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: oldstyle country bumpkin

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.description:
The Innkeeper is a jolly old halfling who spends his days eavesdropping on
local gossip.  In his younger days, he was quite a seasoned traveller.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: The Innkeeper stands here awaiting your order.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: oldstyle innkeeper

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.description: He is a very professional looking type.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: The receptionist sits here, signing forms.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: oldstyle receptionist

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.description:
The shiriff is over waist high, quite tall for a halfling.
He looks at you, smiles and asks you if you have seen a halfling youth
somewhere outside the shire.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: A shiriff of the Shire looks for the lost halfling youth.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: oldstyle shiriff
